stand_up.needs: a bench or chair, seat as for pack 1 chair_sit_idle_m (the seat is drawn under the figure in the level)

prev.why: starts seated; dy_px per previous row: draw stand_up with its anchor y = the previous anchor y - dy_px (screen y down; the pass-1 seated row sits lower against its anchor)

sit_talk.needs: a bench or chair, seat as for pack 1 chair_sit_idle_m (the seat is drawn under the figure in the level)
sit_talk.role: bench: talks seated, small hand gestures (Sitting Answering Questions, loop)

sit_arms_crossed.needs: a bench or chair, seat as for pack 1 chair_sit_idle_m (the seat is drawn under the figure in the level)
sit_arms_crossed.role: bench: crosses his arms and stays so (one-shot: hold the last frame)
sit_arms_crossed.note: motion edit (p2f): both arms go from the knees straight to crossed (0-0.6 s slerped to the 1.2 s pose, p2e/fix/armfix.py + p2f/af_man.json -> p2f/glb/civilian_man_p2f_fix.glb); Meshy's reach thrust an open hand forward at shoulder height first (left sheet frames 1-2)

talk_with_right_hand_open.role: talks / explains with the open right hand at waist height; also the stand-in for "point the way" (the free library has no pointing action)

listen.role: listening idle for conversations (pairs with stand_and_chat): weight shifts, one small hand gesture

shrug.role: "I do not know": palms up at the hips

cower.role: frightened: shields the head with both forearms and turns from the threat to the viewer
cower.note: a stand-in (Stand Dodge 1): it opens in a boxing guard (fists up at the face, frames 0-4), so for a civilian the start reads as squaring up; the shielding turn after it reads as fear. Start it from frame 4 if the guard is unwanted

run_away.role: flees: head down, fists pumping (Male Head-down Charge); loop at the clip speed
run_away.note: ground snapped per clip (the flight phases keep their height)

back_off.role: backs away from a threat with the fists up at the chest (no surrender action in the free library); loop, negative speed
back_off.note: a stand-in: the fists are a boxing guard, so for a civilian it reads as squaring up while backing off rather than as fear; prefer cower or run_away for a frightened bystander
